scares.description: Man looks through slit in the door.
Woman turns to look down the corridor again and sees another woman further away.
As the woman skims through pictures on her camera the next picture has a person standing outside the tent.
Woman starts heading out of tent and a person with a white mask appears from the left side.
Woman looks down and the odd statue is looking up at her now.
Camera flashes on the floor illuminating the same woman from the shot before now in the corner.
The lid on the chest jumps
Same dead looking woman slowly comes out from the dark doorway.
The statue is now standing at the bottom of the stairs.
The cannibal sits right at the foot of Ivan's bed.
The dead bellhop stands right next to Ted.
